'''Drewwa Spaceport''' was the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Drewwa]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Almania]].

[[Ben Skywalker]] landed here in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during a [[Mission for the Amulet of Kalara|mission]] for [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].
